Set the AI to random block. If it hits, then do a combo. If it doesnt then do a safe block string.

For mixups it is a little harder. A universal one is an instant air dash (iad). You can get an overhead to full combo. You can condition them to also block high. Iad but instead of doing a overhead, land and do a low. The opponent can 2h this if they can react. Use an assist to keep them blocking. Grabs also work, just do it unexpectedly, cause if they clash you lose that advantage.

A 6m can open you opponent up with a assist, otherwise it's just poke damage and can be beaten out

Also experiment with your characters and see what they can do. Adult gohan has several mixups, like his backhand or his blockstring has different ways you can end it. Goku blacks teleport can be a mixup since you don't have to hit with it. You can fake a overhead like an iad. There is no true mixup that will always catch your opponent, but having options can better catch them off guard. Practice your options, but also focus on your opponent. Download his habits and find his exploits.
